command: (() => {const f=document.querySelector('#examForm'),d=Dropzone.instances.find(x=>x.element?.id==='hmlDropzone'),files=d.getAcceptedFiles();if(location.pathname!=='/item/difi/form.donga'||files.length!==1||files[0].name!=='QA-DIFI-20261109-01.zip'||files[0].size!==974||f.elements.examDocumentId.value||f.elements.productId.value!=='69'||f.elements.unitCode.value!=='22EMAT0NGS31'||f.elements.startPageNum.value!=='1'||f.elements.endPageNum.value!=='1'||f.elements.serviceUsage.value!=='C'||!f.checkValidity()||f.querySelector('button[type=submit]').disabled)throw Error('QA import precondition mismatch');f.querySelector('button[type=submit]').click();return {action:'Submit actual QA ZIP registration once',file:files[0].name,bytes:files[0].size};})()
